_README: REFERENCE ONLY - the hackathon machine (Arm Farm location, hackathons org) is already configured with arm, gripper, cam, motion and table/wall obstacles. Do NOT push this file over it (viam-machine-config REPLACES the whole config). Frames below are copied from the Viam overview PDF. Fields marked VERIFY are unconfirmed.

components.name: arm
components._model_note: or viam:ufactory:xArm850 - check the CONFIGURE tab

attributes._VERIFY: preconfigured; RealSense attributes include sensors, serial_number

_obstacles_note: table and wall obstacles exist on the machine as erh:vmodutils:obstacle components; the motion service plans around them. Direct arm moves (MoveToPosition / MoveToJointPositions) go straight through them.
